Build a working relationship. Trade access and credit approval are separate. An online application starts a review; it does not automatically open a credit facility. 01 Apply & verify Submit your business and contact details. The team confirms your account, access and pricing. 02 Choose your payment path Pay before production, or ask the office about trade credit. Payment terms are agreed individually. 03 Confirm your terms The office confirms your payment terms in writing after review. Nothing opens automatically. 04 Start working together Once your account is approved, your team gets account access and a named contact. Payment terms are confirmed in writing by the office. Online requests can be made at any time; staff responses and order processing follow office hours. Start my application Already a customer? Sign in WHAT WE SUPPLY One trade account. Your optical's needs - covered. Lenses, coatings, consumables, and the digital tools around them — so your practice isn't stitching together four suppliers to finish one job. Rx lab services Custom surfacing, precision edging, tinting, and specialty coating handled in-house so a job doesn't cross three suppliers before it reaches your bench. Lab process overview Tracing & cutting guide Lens ordering tips Semi-finished & finished lenses Custom-surfaced single vision, bifocal, and progressive prescriptions, plus ready-to-edge stock lenses when the patient needs them this week. Finished lens stock Materials 1.50 – 1.74 Thickness chart Coatings & treatments Anti-reflective, blue-violet management, mirror finishes, hard coat, UV filtering, and hydrophobic top coats — specified per job, not bundled blind. Blue Defense AR+ Mirror finish UV Shield Lab & dispensary supplies Surfacing consumables, finishing supplies, equipment parts, frames, cases, cleaning solutions, and display accessories on one trade account. Optical supplies Vizionize lens cleaner Browse the full store House brands ZenVue Brilliance™ progressives, single vision, and the Darkun™ photochromic family — margin-friendly lines you can build a dispensing story around. ZenVue single vision Photochromic guide ZenVue wholesale Optician website design Modern, bookable websites built specifically for optical retail — custom branding, online booking, and mobile-first layouts, run by our own digital team. Practice details, who does the ordering, and what you dispense most — nothing you have to dig for. ACCOUNT ACCESS IS SUBJECT TO REVIEW Start the application STEP 02 Get your pricing We build your price list around what you actually sell, then walk your team through it — no guessing which column applies to you. ASK FOR A REVISED LIST ANY TIME YOUR MIX CHANGES Request a price list STEP 03 Order the way that suits you Once your account is approved, place prescription and stock orders online or call them in — whichever suits you. ORDERING OPENS ONCE YOUR ACCOUNT IS APPROVED Sign in to open the Rx order form STEP 04 Follow it to the door Stay informed after you order, with freight and delivery handled across the region and a named person to call if anything moves. TURNAROUND VARIES BY RX, MATERIAL, AND COATING Sign in to see order tracking AFTER THE SALE Everything that happens after the order. Freight, remakes, repairs, and customer-supplied frames are all covered by written policy you can read before you commit — not discovered when something goes wrong. Talk to our optical team +1 246 433-4928 A team that answers Dedicated optical consultants for technical questions, not a ticket queue that goes quiet. CUSTOMER SERVICE & HOURS Freight you can plan around Transit times, customs handling, tracking, and delivery support set out in writing before you order. FREIGHT & DELIVERY POLICY Remakes handled properly Clear eligibility, reporting windows, and remake requests — so a problem lens doesn't become a problem week. RETURNS & REPLACEMENTS Your frames, your terms Repairs and customer-supplied frame glazing covered by published policy, including risk and liability. CUSTOMER-SUPPLIED FRAMES COMMON QUESTIONS Straight answers, first time. Practical answers about ordering, delivery and working with our team. Need a hand? Call us and we can walk through the same page together. STILL STUCK? Ask in your own words. We answer first, then point you to the right page. 01 Does Classic Visions sell glasses directly to the public? No. Classic Visions is a wholesale optical laboratory and supplies optical professionals only — opticians, eye clinics, and optical retailers. If you are a patient looking for glasses, use our retailer finder to locate a participating optical practice in your island, and ask them about Classic Visions lenses. Find an optical retailer 02 How do I open a trade account with Classic Visions? Complete the online trade account application with your practice details. Once your account is set up we build a price list around the products you dispense, set up your account access, and introduce you to the person who will look after your account. Apply for a trade account Request a price list 03 What lenses does Classic Visions supply? Custom-surfaced semi-finished lenses and ready-to-edge finished stock lenses in single vision, bifocal, and progressive designs, in materials from index 1.50 to 1.74. Lifestyle options include photochromic, polarized, blue filter, LED PRO, tints, myopia control, and specialty lenses. Compare materials Lens design guide 04 What lens coatings are available? Super AR multi-layer anti-reflective, Blue Defense AR+ for blue-violet management, mirror finishes for fashion and sport, scratch-resistant hard coat, UV Shield for UVA, UVB and blue-violet filtering, and hydrophobic and oleophobic top coats. Browse all coatings How AR coating works 05 Where is Classic Visions located and where do you deliver? The lab is at Uplands Factory, Four Roads, Saint George, Barbados. We supply optical practices across the Caribbean, with freight, customs handling, transit times, and tracking set out in our published freight and delivery policy. Freight & delivery policy 06 How do I place and track a prescription order? Approved trade accounts can place prescription and stock orders online or by phone, and follow their orders after placing them. Confirm production and dispatch timing with the team before committing to a delivery date. Apply for a trade account Customer service & hours 07 How long does a prescription job take? Turnaround depends on the prescription, the lens material, and the coatings specified — a stock finished lens leaves far sooner than a high-index progressive with a mirror finish. Your account contact can confirm a date before you commit to a patient. Lab process overview 08 Can I send patient-owned frames for glazing? Yes. Glazing customer-supplied frames is covered by a published at-risk policy that sets out assessment, risk, and liability, so both sides know where they stand before the frame is cut. Repairs are covered by a separate policy. Customer-supplied frames policy Repairs policy 09 What happens if a lens needs a remake or return? Report it through your account contact or customer service within the reporting window in our returns and replacements policy. The policy sets out what is eligible, how remakes are requested, and what to expect once a remake is raised. Returns & replacements Let's get your account open.
